title: 南宋与民族英雄岳飞
subtitle: The Southern Song & National Hero Yue Fei

cards.back: to fall / perish (a country or dynasty ends)
cards.exampleTranslation: The Northern Song fell.

cards.back: to succeed to the throne (become the new emperor)
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhao Gou became emperor.
The Southern Song court was afraid of the Jin soldiers.

cards.back: to beg for peace / sue for peace
cards.exampleTranslation: Emperor Gaozong wanted to make peace.

cards.back: to resist the Jin (fight against the Jin invaders)
cards.exampleTranslation: The people formed anti-Jin volunteer armies.
The Yue Family Army was a very strong volunteer army.
Yue Fei was a famous general.
Yue Fei defeated the Jin army many times.
They recovered a lot of lost land.
Yue Fei bravely fought the Jin.
